newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS -- up 1/8 to about 1/4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS -- up 1/8 to about 1/4.

text.p: U.S. municipal bonds ended the day up 1/8 to about 1/4 point in moderate activity.
High grade bonds were up an 02 through the long intermediate range. And dollar bonds were up 1/8 to 1/4.
In the primary market, new issue pricing was strong through ten years and firm thererafter.

Goldman Sachs tenatively priced the $549 million Massachusetts GOs at a top yield of 5.30 percent n 2017. In the repricing, the size of the issue was raised to $627 million and yields were cut in various maturities.
Elsewhere in negotitated action, PaineWebber Inc. repriced and restructured a $236 million Harris County, Texas, refunding revenue bonds.
On the competitive side, Lehman Brothers said it won $125 million of Washington State various purpose general obligation refunding bonds at a true interest cost of 5.07 percent.
In the government market, the benchmark 30-year bond at 1600 EDT was off 7/32 at 102-17/32 to yield 6.43 percent.
The September municipal contract was at 121-6/32. The September T-bond contract was 115-12/32. The MOB spread was 186 ticks.
